title: The Debt Collector
text: A devil with a ledger steps into the road, licking a claw to turn the page. It reads out a name, an ancestor of one of your Scions, and a sum. The debt is very old, it says, and the interest has been piling up for centuries.

options.label: Pay off the old debt, and be done with the devil and its ledger.

outcomes.text: The ledger closes with a snap, and the devil looks almost disappointed. It had hoped you would refuse.

options.label: The shrewdest argues the debt is void, and reads the small print closely.

outcomes.text: A clause in the small print, very small. The devil hisses, and tears out the page.
It has better lawyers, and the interest goes up while you argue.

options.label: Refuse, and fight. No House pays a dead ancestor's debts.

outcomes.text: It collects by force, as it always has, and it is very practised.
